# release

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/release"
```

Package release drives every release of a repository through its Release issue \("Release: vX.Y.Z", label release\) on the project board.

Plan notices that develop has changes no release carries yet and opens the issue for the next version. Cut checks the release \(Prepare\) and cuts its branch and pull request into main. A person finalizes the release \(merge and tag\). Verify runs before that merge, and Complete, after the GitHub release is published, attaches it to the issue and closes it. Each records its checks as a comment on the Release issue; a failed check fails the command and leaves the issue open.

## Constants

<a name="StatusPlanned"></a>Board statuses of a Release issue before and after its release.

```go
const (
    StatusPlanned = "Release"
    StatusDone    = "Done"
)
```

<a name="DefaultBot"></a>DefaultBot is the login the Releaser App's installation token acts as. Release issues it opened are its own to plan, rename and flag; issues a person opened are only reused, never renamed or flagged.

```go
const DefaultBot = "blanketops-environments-releaser[bot]"
```

<a name="Label"></a>Label marks Release issues.

```go
const Label = "release"
```

<a name="MainBranch"></a>MainBranch is where releases are merged; release branches are release/\<version\>.

```go
const MainBranch = "main"
```

}

<a name="Options"></a>
## type Options

Options control every command.

```go
type Options struct {
    // Version is the release, vX.Y.Z. Cut works it out when it is empty;
    // Plan ignores it.
    Version string
    // Ref is the branch releases are cut from (Plan, Prepare, Cut).
    Ref string
    // Project, if set, is the board the Release issue is kept on.
    Project *ProjectRef
    // RunURL links the workflow run in comments.
    RunURL string
    // DryRun only reads: nothing is created, commented or closed.
    DryRun bool
    // Bot is the releaser's own login (default DefaultBot).
    Bot string
}
```

<a name="Result"></a>
## type Result

Result is what a command found and did.

```go
type Result struct {
    Stage   Stage
    Version semver.Version
    // Previous is the latest release other than Version (Prepare); nil
    // for a first release.
    Previous *semver.Version
    // Commits are the non-merge commits of the release (Prepare).
    Commits  []semver.Commit
    Required semver.Bump
    // Issue is the Release issue; Number 0 when there is none (or a dry
    // run would create it).
    Issue        github.Issue
    IssueCreated bool
    Milestone    *github.Milestone
    Checks       []Check
    // Warnings do not fail the command.
    Warnings []string
    // Note says why Plan did nothing (nothing to release, a release in
    // progress).
    Note string
    // RenamedFrom is the version Plan moved the planned issue away from.
    RenamedFrom *semver.Version
    // CutSHA is the commit Cut created the release branch at.
    CutSHA string
    // Ref is the branch releases are cut from.
    Ref string
    // Set by Complete.
    Release   *github.Release
    TagSHA    string
    ReleasePR *github.Pull
    Closed    bool
    RunURL    string
    DryRun    bool
}
```

<a name="Complete"></a>
### func Complete

```go
func Complete(ctx context.Context, api API, opts Options) (*Result, error)
```

Complete attaches the published release of Version to its Release issue: it checks that the tag and the GitHub release exist, comments both on the issue, closes it, sets it to Done on the board and closes the version's milestone. A missing Release issue is opened first, so every release has one. When a check fails the issue stays open with a comment saying what is missing.

<a name="Cut"></a>
### func Cut

```go
func Cut(ctx context.Context, api API, opts Options) (*Result, error)
```

Cut cuts the release: it runs Prepare's checks and, when they pass, creates the release branch at Ref's head and opens its pull request into main \(both left as they are when they already exist, so a rerun is safe\). Without a Version it releases the planned Release issue, or the version the commits need. Finalizing \(merge and tag\) stays with a person.

<a name="Plan"></a>
### func Plan

```go
func Plan(ctx context.Context, api API, opts Options) (*Result, error)
```

Plan notices that Ref has changes no release carries yet and keeps one Release issue planned for them, on the board as Release.

With nothing to release, or a planned release whose branch is already cut, it does nothing. With no planned release it opens the issue for the version the commits need. When the planned version no longer covers the commits \(a breaking change landed before its branch was cut\), it renames the issue to the version they need and says why.

<a name="Prepare"></a>
### func Prepare

```go
func Prepare(ctx context.Context, api API, opts Options) (*Result, error)
```

Prepare checks that Version can be released from Ref and opens \(or reuses\) its Release issue on the board with status Release.

It fails when the version is already tagged or is not the next version after the latest release, when the bump is smaller than the commits need, when the Release issue is duplicated or closed, or when the version's milestone still has open items.

<a name="Verify"></a>
### func Verify

```go
func Verify(ctx context.Context, api API, opts Options) (*Result, error)
```

Verify checks, before the release branch is finalized, that Version is not tagged yet, has one open Release issue, no pull request still open into its release branch, and no open milestone item.
